request.text: That's far enough. We know that light. A man carried it here once. He sat on this porch and swore by it, and his word was worth less than the mud. I'm Rue. That's Sedge, and the girl is Tansy. Go down, or go home. Don't stand on my porch. Mud and water, light-bearer. That's all there is out here.
request.voice_description: Native English, British, a broad rural accent of the East Anglian fens. Female, 70-80. Excellent quality. Persona: the eldest of three swamp witches who keep an old hut over black water, sharp-tongued and proud. Emotion: suspicious, scornful, grudging, with a sly, earthy humour. A cracked, reedy, sharp old voice, slow and biting, used to sending people away; softer, almost warm, once she decides to trust.
